basis.governing_question: Why did Vinhos do Douro Lda's export margins fall in 2025?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why export margins fell in 2025 by examining pricing in each export market and distributor terms.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on why export margins fell?

workstreams.name: Pricing by export market
workstreams.answers: How did realized prices and margins move in each export market in 2025, and where did they fall most?
activities: Analyze 2025 sales and margin data by export market
Interview the people who set and approve export prices
Review price lists and pricing documents by market

workstreams.name: Distributor terms
workstreams.answers: How did distributor terms affect export margins in 2025, and which terms weigh most on margin?
activities: Review distributor contracts and agreed terms
Analyze invoice and payment data against agreed terms
Interview staff who manage distributor relationships

deliverables.name: Interim findings on 2025 export margins by market
Findings on pricing by export market
Interim findings on distributor terms and margin
Findings on distributor terms and export margins

events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm the diagnostic scope, team and calendar?
agenda: Present the diagnostic objective and the two workstreams
Align on the pricing and distributor data needed from the client
Confirm the dates of the workshop and the final readout

events.label: Workshop: first findings
events.purpose: Review interim findings and set focus
events.decision: Which markets and distributor terms should the final findings detail further?
agenda: Present interim findings on 2025 export margins by market
Present interim findings on distributor terms and margin
Decide which markets and terms the final findings detail further

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Decide on the findings on export margins
events.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on why export margins fell?
agenda: Present findings on pricing by export market
Present findings on distributor terms and export margins
Decide whether the findings on why export margins fell are accepted

architect_notes: Engagement type is assumed from 'a quick diagnostic'; confirm assessment-only before quoting, because an implementation scope would add phases to the plan.
Departure from the performance_improvement archetype: Implementation dropped because the type is assessment, so one Diagnostic phase covers the stated eight weeks.
Neither stream covers the cost side of export margins; the plan examines only pricing by market and distributor terms.
